geometry: Preserve the exact square canvas, flat-top hex footprint, camera, scale, deep tapered island, centered recessed front stairs, and transparent padding.

The standing patch is only large enough for Pagelet and remains at the same anchor in every stage.
Allow books and architecture to develop throughout the rear and sides without preserving a large empty center.
style: Premium cozy stylized 3D toy diorama matching the approved Pagelet runtime tile.
Chunky rounded clay-like forms, broad soft bevels, matte simplified materials, low-frequency surfaces, warm diffuse light, and clean silhouettes.
Use Pagelet's warm burgundy, cream paper, walnut, antique gold, and amber palette.

persistentLandmarks: The small rear-center book shelter develops into the signature living story archive without changing its anchor.

stages.name: Unwritten Corner
stages.narrative: Pagelet has found a quiet floor, but there is not yet anywhere to keep a story or follow a question.
stages.floor: Mostly bare warm muted walnut floor with only four or five oversized plain planks and broad unfinished space.
stages.landmark: One tiny closed blank book on a low rear-center cream block.
props: one empty broad crate at upper-right
one unlit reading lamp at upper-left
stages.lighting: Soft neutral daylight with no active reading glow.
stages.density: Very sparse, expectant, and visibly incomplete.

stages.name: First Reading Corner
stages.narrative: One shelf, one chair, and one warm lamp make it easy to return to a story.
stages.floor: Broad warm walnut planks remain dominant while the small lower standing patch stays clear.
stages.landmark: The rear-center book block becomes a compact cream shelf holding three oversized books.
props: one chunky reading chair and broad lamp at upper-left
stages.lighting: Warm daylight with one broad amber reading-lamp pool.
stages.density: A modest reading corner made from a few bold useful forms.

stages.name: Pocket Library
stages.narrative: Pagelet establishes a dependable home for beloved books, questions, and ideas worth keeping.
stages.floor: Six to eight oversized smooth walnut planks establish the library without fine grain or loose paper.
stages.landmark: The rear-center shelf becomes a compact open-front cream library nook with curved burgundy roof and arched doorway.
props: one large blank open book on a lectern
one reading chair and lamp at upper-left
one book cart and lamp at upper-right
stages.lighting: Soft warm daylight with three broad amber reading pools.

stages.name: Story Hall
stages.narrative: The library becomes a welcoming hall where curiosity can be shared and followed further.
stages.floor: Rich broad walnut and cream floor masses frame the small lower standing patch without creating a plaza.
stages.landmark: The same nook grows into a rounded two-wing story hall with taller burgundy roof and glowing arched doorway.
stages.lighting: Golden library daylight with restrained warm doorway and lamp glow.
stages.density: Rich and welcoming using bold shelves and architecture, not tiny books.

stages.name: Living Story Archive
stages.narrative: Pagelet's home becomes the Haven's definitive landmark for curiosity, memory, and stories still unfolding.
stages.floor: Polished low-detail walnut library flooring surrounds the small lower standing patch in broad readable masses.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center hall culminates in a signature grand curved archive with layered burgundy roof, luminous cream arch, and one oversized closed-book emblem without writing.
props: the resolved upper-right book and lamp point
stages.lighting: Warm luminous golden-hour library light with a magical but restrained archive glow.
stages.density: Definitive signature landmark with abundant large forms and no micro-detail.
